caveats:
Points extracted from OSM and matched with names from the 2011 census - http://www.dominica.gov.dm/cms/files/2011_census_report.pdf.  Data should be verified against the pdf for transcribing errors. Locations matched manually to OSM data - all locations need verifying.

Revision history:

V4:  P-code for Soufriere corrected from DM07-001 (which was a duplicate) to DM07-002.

V3:  These files consolidate Berricoa, Ravine Banane (which is deserted), and Hagley into Grandbay and consolidate Glanvilla and Picard into Portsmouth, as per the latest understanding of the community structure in Dominica.
methodology_other: Extract from Open Street Map.  Please see caveats below.
name: dominica-populated-places
notes:
This file contains 143 populated places in Dominica, with P-codes to administrative level 1.

(This file replaces "dma_stle_stl_pt_s1_dominode_pp_V3.zip" uploaded 2017 09 20.)

The file can be joined to the Dominica Population Statistics COD found on HDX.
